staff_keys_suspect_is_revoked.name: staff_keys_suspect_is_revoked
staff_keys_suspect_is_revoked.value: "auth"."staff_keys"."suspect_at" is null or "auth"."staff_keys"."revoked_at" is not null

post_media_ready_has_dims.name: post_media_ready_has_dims
post_media_ready_has_dims.value: "post_media"."status" <> 'ready' or ("post_media"."width" is not null and "post_media"."height" is not null and "post_media"."blurhash" is not null)

post_media_attached_is_complete.name: post_media_attached_is_complete
post_media_attached_is_complete.value: "post_media"."post_id" is null or ("post_media"."status" = 'ready' and "post_media"."position" between 0 and 3 and "post_media"."alt_text" is not null)

audit_log_step_up_complete.name: audit_log_step_up_complete
audit_log_step_up_complete.value: ("audit_log"."action_hash" is null) = ("audit_log"."step_up" is null) and ("audit_log"."action_hash" is null or "audit_log"."key_id" is not null)
